categories.label: Breakout today
categories.meaning: Closed above its closing trigger (the last confirmed swing high) today with higher highs and higher lows. Plan: buy at the next open only if it opens inside the entry band.

categories.label: Ready to break
categories.meaning: Rising structure (higher highs + higher lows) and the close is within 1 ATR of the trigger. Plan: buy only after a daily CLOSE above the trigger.

categories.label: Uptrend - wait
categories.meaning: Rising structure, but price is not near a fresh trigger. Holders trail the stop; new buyers wait for the trigger close or a dip to support.

categories.label: Turning up
categories.meaning: Mixed structure but trend indicators have turned up. Not a buy yet: it needs a higher low and a close above the trigger.

categories.label: Sideways / no trend
categories.meaning: No clear direction. Stay out until price closes above the trigger (bullish) or below the structure exit (bearish).

categories.label: Structure exit today
categories.meaning: Closed below its last confirmed swing low TODAY. Longs exit at the next open. Bearish trades only through F&O (no overnight short in cash).

categories.label: Below structure
categories.meaning: Already broke its last swing low on an earlier day and has not repaired. Avoid buying; wait for a new higher low.

categories.label: Downtrend
categories.meaning: Lower highs and lower lows. Avoid buying; bounces into resistance are selling zones for F&O traders.

categories.label: Data check
categories.meaning: Incomplete or suspect price data for this session, so no plan is shown.

events.label: Broke out today
events.meaning: Closed above its closing trigger (last confirmed swing high).

events.label: Structure exit today
events.meaning: Closed below its last confirmed swing low: exit condition for longs.

events.label: Hit target
events.meaning: Reached the next target of yesterday's plan during today's session.

events.label: Hit stop
events.meaning: Touched the stop loss of yesterday's plan during today's session.

events.label: Category upgraded
events.meaning: Moved to a more bullish category than yesterday.

events.label: Category downgraded
events.meaning: Moved to a more bearish category than yesterday.

events.label: Supertrend flipped up
events.meaning: Closed above the Supertrend line: trend turned up today.

events.label: Supertrend flipped down
events.meaning: Closed below the Supertrend line: trend turned down today.

events.label: RSI crossed 55
events.meaning: RSI moved above 55 today: buyers took control.

events.label: RSI crossed 45
events.meaning: RSI fell below 45 today: sellers took control.

events.label: Closed above upper band
events.meaning: First close above the upper Bollinger band: volatility expanding upward.

events.label: Closed below lower band
events.meaning: First close below the lower Bollinger band: volatility expanding downward.

events.label: Bollinger squeeze
events.meaning: Bands are among their narrowest of the window: a large move often follows.

events.label: Volume 2x average
events.meaning: Today's volume was at least twice the 20-session average.

events.label: New 20-day high close
events.meaning: Closed above every high of the previous 20 sessions.

events.label: New 20-day low close
events.meaning: Closed below every low of the previous 20 sessions.

events.label: In Fib golden zone
events.meaning: Price sits in the 50-61.8% retracement: the most watched pullback zone.

events.label: Crossed a Fib level
events.meaning: Today's close crossed a Fibonacci level that yesterday's close had not.

events.label: Reached Fib extension
events.meaning: Today's range reached the 127.2% or 161.8% extension of the auto leg.

factors.name: HH/HL structure
factors.rule: HH/HL = 20 bull; LH/LL = 20 bear; mixed or unconfirmed = 0.

factors.name: Trigger / structure exit
factors.rule: Breakout today 15 bull; structure exit today 15 bear; still below structure exit 10 bear; HH/HL within 1 ATR under the trigger 8 bull; HH/HL above the trigger 5 bull.

factors.name: ADX (14) + DI
factors.rule: ADX >= 25: 10 to the side whose DI leads; ADX 20-25: 5; below 20: 0.

factors.name: RSI (14)
factors.rule: (RSI - 50) / 2, capped at 10: RSI 70 = 10 bull, RSI 30 = 10 bear.

factors.name: Fibonacci position (auto anchor)
factors.rule: Trend leg intact and retraced < 38.2% (or new extreme) = 5 to the leg's side; 38.2-61.8% = 2 to the leg's side; 78.6-100% = 3 against; leg failed > 100% = 5 against.

factors.name: Volume
factors.rule: Volume >= 1.5x its 20-session average: 5 to the side of today's candle.

buy.label: Buy
buy.meaning: Rising structure (higher highs and higher lows). Ranked by Jev score out of 100, highest first.

sell.label: Sell
sell.meaning: Broken or falling structure. Ranked by Jev sell score = 100 - Jev score (weakest Jev setup first). Sell = exit longs / bearish via F&O.

watch.label: Watch
watch.meaning: No confirmed direction yet. Ranked by Jev score out of 100 (nearest to becoming a buy first); the chart lean is shown.

jev_method.formula: Jev score = 35 x setup_quality/4 + 30 x follow_through/4 + 35 x risk_reward/4
jev_method.not_scored: Stocks Jev did not assess follow in chart-score order.

accounting.words: 236 stocks = 79 Buy + 61 Sell + 96 Watch + 0 not ranked. Jev-scored: 200 = 66 Buy + 54 Sell + 80 Watch. Without a Jev score: Nifty 200 0 of 200, F&O extra 36 of 36.

supertrend.name: Supertrend (10, 3)
supertrend.how: Green line under price = uptrend; red line above price = downtrend. A close through the line flips it.

adx.name: ADX (14)
adx.how: Below 20 = choppy, 20-25 = trend forming, above 25 = strong trend. +DI above -DI means buyers lead.

rsi.name: RSI (14)
rsi.how: Above 55 = buyers in control, below 45 = sellers in control. Above 70 is stretched, below 30 is washed out.

bollinger.name: Bollinger Bands (20, 2)
bollinger.how: Price riding the upper band = strong; lower band = weak. Very narrow bands (squeeze) often come before a big move.

obv.name: OBV vs 20-day EMA
obv.how: OBV adds volume on up days and subtracts it on down days. Above its average and rising = accumulation.

vwap20.name: VWAP-20
vwap20.how: Average price paid over 20 sessions, weighted by volume. Price above it = buyers are in profit.

method.conviction: Directional setups only: (indicators agreeing with the category / 5) x 60 + Jev composite x 40 (halved when Jev disagrees; 20 points when Jev has no view).
method.long_stop: Higher of the structure exit and entry - 2 x ATR14 (scanner rule).
method.targets: T1 = nearest confirmed swing high above entry (or 1.5R if none within 2R), T2 = 2R, T3 = 3R. Bearish setups mirror this with swing lows.
method.hedges: F&O names only. Premiums are Black-Scholes estimates from end-of-day ATM IV and the official lot size.
method.fibonacci: Three anchors per stock (last 3 x ATR zigzag leg, 3-month range, 6-month range). Each is scored by how often price reacted at its 38.2-78.6% levels after the leg ended; the best fit is 'auto'. Daily candles only - there is no intraday data.
method.events: Compared with the previous session: yesterday's published list when it exists, otherwise yesterday's plan rebuilt from the levels known at yesterday's close. Target / stop hits use today's high and low.

limitations: End-of-day research, not live quotes and not investment advice. No strategy here is validated as profitable.
Categories describe what price has done; they do not predict that targets will be reached.
Option premiums are model estimates; check the live chain, liquidity and margin before trading.
Short trades are shown only for F&O names; cash shares cannot be shorted overnight.
